alarms.action: Set alarm M290, abort sequence to VENT step (M205), set FAIL result (M211), light ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25)
alarms.condition: PT-2001 pack pressure does not reach fill complete threshold (14.50 kPa) within 8.0 s (T21 done)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latch alarm M291, close fill valve XV-2003 (Y21), hold vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open, abort sequence to VENT step (M205), set FAIL result (M211), light ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25)
alarms.condition: PT-2001 pack pressure exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123)
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Activate M292, inhibit cycle start, hold unclamp with vent open, light ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25)
alarms.condition: PT-2001 pack pressure reading falls below -5.00 kPa (D100 < -500, indicating wire break)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latch alarm M293, abort sequence to VENT step (M205), set FAIL result (M211), light ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25)
alarms.condition: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 opens (X22 OFF) while ST20 is busy (M200 ON)
alarms.name: Supply air low

alarms.action: Activate fault M299, abort running cycle to VENT step (M205), set FAIL result (M211), light ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25)
alarms.condition: E-stop chain healthy contact ES-0001 opens (X0 OFF)
alarms.name: E-stop lost

interlocks.cause: Cell not in auto mode (X2 OFF), ST20 fault active (M299 ON), or station busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit start of test cycle upon pallet arrival (ZS-2008 / X23 rising edge)

interlocks.cause: Clamp not confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF or ZS-2002B / X21 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit transition to FILL step; fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) cannot open and closes immediately if clamp confirmation is lost

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure not vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 >= 100) or PT-2001 signal fault active (M292 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit unclamp; station holds in VENT step with vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open

interlocks.cause: Overpressure detected (PT-2001 reading D100 > 20.00 kPa / D123)
interlocks.effect: Latch overpressure alarm M291, immediately close fill valve XV-2003, hold vent valve XV-2004 open, and abort cycle to VENT with FAIL result (M211)

interlocks.cause: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 lost (X22 OFF) while station is busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Latch supply air low alarm M293 and abort cycle to VENT with FAIL result (M211)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain healthy contact ES-0001 lost (X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Set fault flag M299, energize ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25), and abort cycle to VENT with FAIL result

interlocks.cause: Manual mode active (X2 OFF) and manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 pressed (X25 ON)
Station not in DONE step (M207 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) and FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) output signals to line controller

steps.entry: Pallet leaves test position (ZS-2008 / X23 OFF) at completion of previous cycle or controller initialisation.
steps.exit: Pallet arrives in test position (ZS-2008 / X23 rising edge) with cell in auto mode (SS-0003 / X2 ON), no ST20 fault active (M299 OFF), and station not busy (M200 OFF).
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: Pallet arrival trigger initiates cycle: station busy set (M200), clamp step set (M201), clamp solenoid XY-2002 energized (Y20).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed by ZS-2002A (X20 ON) and open limit switch ZS-2002B clear (X21 OFF).
steps.name: CLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp closed confirmed: fill step set (M202), fill valve XV-2003 opened (Y21), fill timeout timer T21 started.
steps.exit: PT-2001 pack pressure reaches 14.50 kPa (D100 >= D122), or fill timeout expires (T21 done after 8.0 s) / fault occurs aborting to VENT.
steps.name: FILL

steps.entry: Fill complete threshold reached: fill step reset (M202 OFF), fill valve XV-2003 closed, stabilise step set (M203), stabilise timer T22 started.
steps.exit: Stabilisation timer T22 expires (3 s per narrative / 5.0 s per parameter sheet); baseline pressure recorded into D110.
steps.name: STABILISE

steps.entry: Stabilisation timer done: test step set (M204), pack remains isolated, test window timer T23 started (10.0 s).
steps.exit: Test window timer T23 expires: final pressure recorded into D111, decay calculated (D112 = D110 - D111), PASS (M210) or FAIL (M211) latched.
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Test window expires, or abort condition triggered by active fault (M299), fill timeout (M290), overpressure (M291), or E-stop loss: vent valve XV-2004 opened (Y22).
steps.exit: Vent timer done, pack pressure vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < 100), and PT-2001 signal healthy (M292 OFF).
steps.name: VENT

steps.entry: Vent conditions satisfied: unclamp step set (M206), clamp solenoid XY-2002 de-energized (Y20 OFF).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open by ZS-2002B (X21 ON) and clamp closed switch clear (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF).
steps.name: UNCLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open: done step set (M207), PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) or FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) result signalled to line controller.
steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (ZS-2008 / X23 OFF): done step reset (M207 OFF) and station busy cleared (M200 OFF), returning station to IDLE.
steps.name: DONE
